title: Announce each new verdict once
statement: Announce each new piece of feedback once to assistive technology and keep restored earlier feedback quiet, so a screen-reader user never hears an old verdict as new.
example: The repaired status passed 5 of 5 checks on the real components, each of which the old build failed as intended.
detail: An audit of reading lessons found that several answer types, among them free responses, sequences and checked multi-select items, gave no lasting accessible update, while wrapping the whole reply history in a live region would have replayed old verdicts on every revisit. The repair put a small, stable, polite status at each interaction that announces each newly settled verdict, stays quiet for restored or repeated history and respects pending and outage states. Its tests passed 5 of 5 on the real components against 5 intended failures on the old build.
against: Untested with real assistive technology: "Actual assistive-tech speech remains separately open at reading-9ur.17." (grade3-reading/ui-audit-2026-09-08/BEAD-REGISTER.json, line 3223)

evidence.quote: Several Reply owners lack a persistent accessible update, while generic live-wrapping history would replay old verdicts.
A small stable polite status at interaction owners announces each new settled identity, suppresses restored/repeated history and respects pending/outage transitions.
Submit a free response, sequence or checked MSQ; inspect the stable live region and revisit/history transitions.
